summary: Verified fresh import of KosManager (Expo web preview, mobile 390x844). All 7 requested smoke flows pass end-to-end on https://kos-rental-1.preview.emergentagent.com/. (1) App loads in ~20-25s on mobile viewport, Beranda dashboard renders with greeting, PIN banner, income/expense/net card, 4 stat tiles, Aksi Cepat, Jatuh Tempo, Belum Bayar, Pembayaran Terakhir, and 4-tab bar (Beranda/Kamar/Penghuni/Keuangan). (2) Kamar: created A1 (Rp 1.000.000) via rooms-add-fab + room-save-button; duplicate A1 submission rejected (form stays, user kept on form with error) ; B2 (Rp 800.000) created; both listed as 'Kosong'. (3) Penghuni: tenants-add-fab → tenant Budi TEST created with room A1 assigned (chip tenant-room-1), phone 08123456789, entry 2026-07-01; tenant detail shows 'A1' and 'Aktif' badge; Checkout + Hapus buttons visible; tenants-search-input available (KTP picker not tested on web — Kamera/Galeri buttons present and testIDs exist, didn't crash on render). (4) Catat Bayar: quick-pay → payment-form shows payment-tenant-1 chip; selecting it auto-fills payment-amount-input with 1.000.000 ; payment-status-lunas and payment-status-dp chips present; payment-save-button → navigates to Kuitansi page with receipt no KW/202610/0001, tenant Budi TEST, kamar A1, periode Oktober 2026, metode Tunai, Rp 1.000.000, LUNAS badge, Kirim WhatsApp + Simpan/Bagikan PDF + Hapus Pembayaran buttons. (5) Keuangan: finance-add-expense → cash-form saved Listrik Rp 150.000; finance-add-income → saved Pemasukan Lain Rp 200.000; finance-summary shows income Rp 200.000, expense Rp 150.000, net Rp 50.000 (in a fresh session without payment). Rekap tab shows 'Rincian Oktober 2026' categorized: Sewa kamar Rp 0, Pemasukan lain Rp 200.000, − Listrik -Rp 150.000, Saldo bersih Rp 50.000, plus '6 Bulan Terakhir' bar chart with Mei..Okt and Export Laporan PDF. (6) Filter panel: finance-filter-button opens finance-filter-sheet with filter-preset-7/30/lastmonth, filter-from/to, Kamar + Penghuni chips, filter-reset + filter-apply — all testIDs present and renders cleanly. (7) Pengaturan (home-settings-button → settings-screen): Profil Kos (Nama Kos / Pemilik + Simpan Profil), KEAMANAN (Atur PIN, Sidik Jari toggle (disabled on web), Kunci Sekarang after PIN set, Nonaktifkan PIN), BACKUP & RESTORE (Unduh Backup .json, Import). Set PIN=1234 → confirm 1234 → 'PIN berhasil disimpan' toast + settings-lock-now and settings-remove-pin appear. settings-lock-now → lock-screen 'Masukkan PIN' with lock-pin-key-0..9 → entered 1234 → unlocked back to settings. No crashes on any screen. (8) Beranda counters correctly reflect in-session data (income Rp 200.000 / expense Rp 150.000 after cash entries). No PAGEERROR or CONSOLE_ERROR captured during entire run — only harmless RN-Web deprecation warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. No breaking issues from the GitHub import.

issues: Carried over from iter_3: preset date buttons sit below the fold inside the bottom-sheet ScrollView when parties chips render on Pemasukan tab — users need to scroll inside the sheet. Not a regression, just a known UX note.

react_native_issues.issue: react-native-web deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — use 'boxShadow'. Non-fatal, but worth migrating before RN 0.76+ full removal.

critical_code_review_comments: Expo web uses in-memory sql.js — data resets on each new browser session (not persisted to IndexedDB). Acceptable for offline-first native target but worth documenting for web preview users to avoid confusion.

Backup download via settings-export-share on web uses Print/Share flow — Playwright page.expect_download did not fire within 10s in automated run (manual click works, no crash). On RN-Web the download is produced via a blob+anchor click inside share.ts shareBackup; if download event is required for automated backup regression, prefer intercepting the <a download> click via DOM rather than page.expect_download.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested smoke flows (7/7) pass without crash

seed_data_creation: Per-session sql.js seed: Room A1 (Rp 1.000.000), Room B2 (Rp 800.000), Tenant 'Budi TEST' (room A1, entry 2026-07-01, phone 08123456789), Payment KW/202610/0001 Rp 1.000.000 LUNAS for Budi/periode 2026-10. Separate session: expense 'Listrik TEST' Rp 150.000 + income lain 'Pemasukan Lain TEST' Rp 200.000. PIN=1234 configured in settings test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GitHub import https://github.com/choirul378/kos.git branch main works out-of-the-box on web preview with no code changes needed. Container date is 2026-10-09. Frontend served by Expo dev server on port 3000 via supervisor; initial WASM/sql.js load takes 20-25s on cold start — always await 25s before first wait_for_selector. Mobile viewport 390x844 required. sql.js in-memory DB resets per browser session; seed data every test run via UI. Key testIDs: tab-{index,rooms,tenants,finance}, rooms-add-fab, room-{number,price,save}-{input,button}, tenants-add-fab, tenant-{name,phone,entry-date,save}-{input,button}, tenant-room-<id> chip, quick-pay/quick-tenant/quick-room/quick-expense, payment-{tenant-<id>,amount-input,status-lunas,status-dp,save-button}, finance-{add-income,add-expense,filter-button,tab-masuk/keluar/rekap,income-value,expense-value,net-value}, cash-{amount,desc,save}-input/button, home-settings-button, settings-{pin-row,lock-now,remove-pin,export-share,import}, setup-pin-key-N / setup-pin-submit, lock-pin-key-N. Chips inside horizontal ScrollViews require scroll_into_view_if_needed before click. After tenant save the app replaces route to /tenant/<id> (detail screen) which hides tab bar — use page.goto('/tenants') or back button to continue. Backup download on web uses blob+anchor; page.expect_download may not fire in Playwright in 10s but the action itself does not crash.
